details:
Summary

After updating Steam Link from v2.0.19 to v2.0.20 or newer, VRChat becomes unplayable on Meta Quest 3S.

The same hardware, Windows installation, SteamVR version and VRChat version work perfectly on Steam Link v2.0.19.

The issue is 100% reproducible.

Steps to reproduce

1. Launch Steam Link (v2.0.20 or newer).

2. Connect to a Windows PC.

3. Launch SteamVR.

4. Start VRChat in VR mode.

5. Wait until the loading screen or main menu appears.

Expected Result

Normal 6DoF head tracking.

Normal controller tracking.

Normal SlimeVR tracking.

Stable camera movement.

Actual Result

The bug appears immediately at the loading screen and before entering any world.

- Head tracking becomes incorrect.

- Positional tracking stops working.

- The world follows the headset.

- The image shakes during movement.

- Controllers appear behind the player or above the head.

- Controller orientation is incorrect.

- SlimeVR trackers also stop working correctly.

- The avatar sinks into the floor.

SteamVR Home works perfectly.

Standalone Quest VRChat works perfectly.

Only PCVR VRChat through Steam Link v2.0.20+ is affected.

Additional Details

Hardware

Meta Quest 3S (128 GB)

Intel i5-10400F

GTX 1660 Super 6 GB

16 GB RAM

Windows 10 Home

SteamVR Stable

Steam Link v2.0.20+

Ethernet PC

5 GHz Wi-Fi (TP-Link Deco AC1200 Mesh)

The issue does NOT exist on Steam Link v2.0.19.

Steam Support has already reviewed my report and recommended that I also report it to VRChat.

Steam Support ticket:

HT-CDCF-CDPQ-F834

SteamVR bug report:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/250820/discussions/3/798965575663559455/

Video:

https://youtu.be/WB_okE8CQwc
title: Steam Link v2.0.20+ causes broken tracking on Meta Quest 3S (works correctly on v2.0.19)
